facts.note: Transcript gives the bell striking nine at dinner, watches shown, Félix's watch at twenty minutes to nine, and Aurèle scolding him for it.
When the temple struck ten, Mme Monnier looked at the salon clock, which showed five minutes to ten.
Piquet in the salon without a break until the doctor got up for his cigars; he went out at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
He asked her to play as he went out; she sat at the piano at once, played until he came back, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
